paragraphs.notes: Boxed table of bare numbers at the head of the page under a centred (fortgesetzt) caption. It carries no claim number, no column headings and no unit on this page. It is the tail of the band-maxima list of claim 4 (Raman-Spektrum, Bandenmaxima angegeben in cm-1), which begins on page 12: the four columns continue, strictly ascending, the four columns of the second list on page 12 (91 ... 311 / 507 ... 687 / 921 ... 1166 / 1337 ... 1679). That attribution is read off page 12, not off this page, so it is also recorded in discrepancies. Layout: 4 columns, 6 rows, 24 values, all present, all integers with no decimal separator. Column-major, i.e. each column ascends and the next column continues from the previous one. The extracted text layer flattens this row-major as 363 738 1176 2888 402 775 ..., which reads as one interleaved series and is wrong; the columns above are read off the page image and the digits confirmed against the text layer. Only the six rows printed on this page are recorded; the earlier rows are on page 12 and are not repeated. A ruled vertical line is printed between column 2 and column 3 only; it is a typesetting artifact of the boxed table and carries no meaning. The list ends here. Page-level: the left margin carries the EPO column line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, which are typesetting furniture and are not transcribed as content. The page is born-digital single-column claims text; every character was taken from the extracted text layer and only the two table layouts were read off the image. drawings is empty because the page carries no chemical structure and no reaction scheme at all, only two boxed tables of numbers; the empty array is a finding, not an omission.

Claim 5. The paragraph marker is the printed claim number, since the claims carry no [00NN] markers. The boxed table below the claim text belongs to claim 5: it is the only numeric list between claim 5 and claim 6, it sits directly under the claim 5 sentence that ends in a colon, and its values are in the range expected for degrees 2theta. Layout: 4 columns, 13 rows, but column 4 has only 10 values, so the last three cells of column 4 are empty on the page and are left empty in the markdown table. Value count: 13 + 13 + 13 + 10 = 49. Column-major and strictly ascending across the four columns (7.3765 to 36.7974). The text layer flattens it row-major (7.3765 20.8117 26.6207 32.4069 8.0674 ...), with the last three rows carrying only three values each, which confirms the column count and the ragged fourth column. Every value in this table is printed with a decimal POINT and four decimal places, unlike the German decimal comma used in claim 6 and claim 7 on the same page; recorded as printed. The page prints the Greek letter theta in Grad 2θ and it is recorded as the character θ. A ruled vertical line is printed between column 2 and column 3 only, as in the table at the head of the page; typesetting artifact. Roentgen-Pulver-Diffraktometrie keeps its hyphens: they are real, not line-break hyphens.

paragraphs.zh:
6.	Kristallmodifikation nach Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass die Elementarzelle folgende Dimensionen aufweist:
|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| a = 31,1647(18) Å | α =90° |
| b = 10,3522(6) Å | β = 90° |
| c = 5,5449(3) Å | γ = 90°: |
paragraphs.en:
6.	Crystal modification according to claim 1, characterised in that the unit cell has the following dimensions:
|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| a = 31,1647(18) Å | α =90° |
| b = 10,3522(6) Å | β = 90° |
| c = 5,5449(3) Å | γ = 90°: |
paragraphs.notes: Claim 6. The unit-cell block is printed centred under the claim, in two columns of three lines, with no ruled border of its own (unlike the two boxed numeric tables on this page). It is recorded as a 2 x 3 markdown table only so that the pairing of each axis length with its angle is preserved for downstream passes; do not read the borders as printed. Values use the German decimal comma and the parenthesised standard uncertainty on the last digits, as printed: 31,1647(18), 10,3522(6), 5,5449(3), unit Å. The angles are printed with irregular spacing: the alpha line reads α =90° with the space before the equals sign and none after, while beta and gamma read β = 90° and γ = 90°; reproduced as printed. The gamma line ends in a colon (90°:) even though nothing follows it and claim 7 begins a new numbered claim; that stray colon is on the page and is transcribed. All three angles are 90 degrees, consistent with the orthorhombic system of claim 1, but that consistency is an observation, not an inference used to read any digit.

paragraphs.zh: 7.	Kristallmodifikation nach Anspruch 1 mit einem Schmelzpunkt von 124,0°C.
paragraphs.en: 7.	Crystal modification according to claim 1 having a melting point of 124,0°C.
paragraphs.notes: Claim 7, one line, complete on this page. The melting point is printed with the German decimal comma, 124,0°C, and is left with the comma in both zh and en so that the en field is not silently renumbered into English punctuation.

paragraphs.zh:
8.	Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man
a) eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione in Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst und
b) bis zur quantitativen Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C behandelt.
paragraphs.en:
8.	Process for preparing the thermodynamically stable crystal modification according to claim 1, characterised in that
a) a metastable crystal modification or a mixture of the metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione is suspended and/or dissolved in solvents and
b) is treated at temperatures of 0°C to 80°C until quantitative conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification.
paragraphs.notes: Claim 8, with lettered sub-paragraphs a) and b) set as a separate indented block. Two line-break hyphens repaired: gekenn-zeichnet to gekennzeichnet and Tem-botrione to Tembotrione. The temperature range is printed 0°C bis 80°C and the degree signs are on the page.

paragraphs.zh: 9.	Verfahren gemäß Anspruch 8, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass als Lösungsmittel Alkohole oder Ketone verwendet werden.
paragraphs.en: 9.	Process according to claim 8, characterised in that alcohols or ketones are used as solvents.
paragraphs.notes: Claim 9, complete on this page. No hyphenation to repair.

paragraphs.zh: 10.	Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation gemäß Anspruch 1, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass man eine metastabile Kristallmodifikation oder ein Gemisch der metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen von Tembotrione unter hohem Druck, mindestens 5 bar, mahlt.
paragraphs.en: 10.	Process for preparing the thermodynamically stable crystal modification according to claim 1, characterised in that a metastable crystal modification or a mixture of the metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione is milled under high pressure, at least 5 bar.
paragraphs.notes: Claim 10, complete on this page. One line-break hyphen repaired: gekenn-zeichnet to gekennzeichnet. The pressure is printed mindestens 5 bar.

paragraphs.zh: 11.	Herbizides Mittel, gekennzeichnet durch einen Gehalt an thermodynamisch stabiler Kristallmodifikation von Tembotrione gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 und gängigen Streckmitteln und/oder oberflächenaktiven Hilfsstoffen.
paragraphs.en: 11.	Herbicidal composition, characterised by a content of thermodynamically stable crystal modification of tembotrione according to any of claims 1 to 7 and customary extenders and/or surface-active adjuvants.
paragraphs.notes: Claim 11, the last claim printed on this page. One line-break hyphen repaired: Tem-botrione to Tembotrione. No Gew.-% figure is printed in this claim: the composition claim gives no percentage range at all, only a content of the stable modification plus extenders and/or surface-active adjuvants. Nothing follows claim 11 on this page, so it is not visible from here whether the claim set ends at 11.

discrepancies.what: The number table at the head of the page carries no claim number, so its owner cannot be established from this page alone.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The boxed table prints only the caption (fortgesetzt) above 4 columns of 6 integers (363 to 3075). No claim number, no column heading and no unit appear on page 13.
discrepancies.text_says: Page 12 ends with claim 4 (Raman-Spektrum, Bandenmaxima angegeben in cm-1) followed by two unlabelled 4-column lists; the four columns of this continuation ascend directly out of the four columns of the second of those lists, so it is the tail of claim 4. That is evidence from page 12, not from page 13, and the unit cm-1 is therefore not asserted on this page.

discrepancies.what: The task brief anticipated a density claim among the claims on this page; no such claim is printed here.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The claims printed on this page are 5 (X-ray powder diffractometry), 6 (unit cell), 7 (melting point 124,0°C), 8 and 10 (processes), 9 (solvents) and 11 (herbicidal composition). No g/cm3 value and no Dichte appears anywhere on page 13.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 11 back-refers to Ansprueche 1 bis 7, and claims 1 to 4 are on page 12 (orthorhombic system, space group Pna21, infrared spectrum, Raman spectrum), so claims 1 to 7 are fully accounted for without a density claim. A density may be recited in the description rather than in the claims; that is not decided here.

blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
